outcome: Adherence to Institute of Medicine (IOM) gestational weight gain recommendations
cohort: 986 pregnant women between November 2011 and November 2015 at Atatürk Education and Research Hospital, Ankara, Turkey
finding: Higher pre-pregnancy BMI was associated with increased maternal complications and lower adherence to IOM gestational weight gain recommendations, while gestational weight gain was positively associated with infant birth weight.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
